verdicts.reason: In A, the hard line breaks left 'fellow' and 'help' alone on their own lines, which makes the quote ragged and hard to read. The text block is also crowded against the top edge, and the yellow bar ends right where the copy starts. B keeps the original four-line wrap, places the text block and attribution cleanly beside the skull, and holds the hierarchy. Its flaws are that the yellow bar almost touches the start of the quote text and there is a large empty band on the right.
